review.why: Writes a resume for a career change or return to work, mapping transferable evidence without relabeling past jobs.
review.summary: Establishes the target profession, prior work and completed transition steps, builds a table from target requirement to prior action, transferable capability and limit, then writes a bridge headline and summary, selected projects and a dated history. It covers military-to-civilian wording and returners, and keeps unearned titles out of the resume.
strengths: Never lists the target title as a job already held
Keeps projects, coursework and volunteering labeled as such
Worked example with the exact line to avoid
cautions: Instructions only: no layout or template files
Depends on facts the user can supply about the transition
Promises neither interviews nor an ATS score, by design
